title: Run CI on Windows
notes: Windows is a target since PR #191. CI runs on Ubuntu only, so a change can break Windows start or packaging unseen. Add a windows-latest job to the CI workflow: npm ci (node-pty builds there), npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, and a make of the Windows installer (Forge squirrel maker) without publishing. Mark tests that need a POSIX shell or unix sockets so they skip on win32 with a reason, rather than failing; list them in the PR.

comments.body: Shipped in #197: windows-latest CI job (npm ci, tsc, tests, Squirrel make, no publish); premake runs the running-app guard and node-pty copy; .dashboard/*.md checked out LF; 39 POSIX-only tests skip on win32 with reasons. Not done: pane host and session pipe Windows bugs (#198), portable path fixtures (Backlog card).
